run_benchmark_pipeline: run a diffusion model benchmark with configurable compilation, quantization, and precision options
load_diffusion_pipeline: load a diffusion pipeline with UNet and VAE compilation, attention mode, and quantization settings
benchmark_inference_speed: benchmark inference speed of a diffusion pipeline and return timing in seconds
generate_benchmark_csv: generate a CSV dictionary from benchmark results including timing, memory, and configuration parameters
write_benchmark_results: write benchmark results dictionary to a CSV file with standardized field headers
